name: codebuddy-first-bridge
description: codebuddy-first bridge for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): prioritize the local codebuddy CLI in every mode (full DSH control, no prompts), with a rate-limit/network fallback dialog, a live status light (dynamic form + home-level plugin), per-project token usage accounting, and a zero-dependency MCP server so any MCP-capable agent (Claude Code / Codex / Cherry Studio …) discovers codebuddy itself. Single npm package: install the home-level status light via `dsh plugin --profile web add codebuddy-first-bridge`.

scripts.check: node mcp/codebuddy-mcp-server.mjs --check && node scripts/verify.mjs && npm test
